rules.name: S&P 500 with a 10-month trend filter
rules.desc: Hold SPY while its month-end price is above its 10-month average; otherwise Treasury bills (BIL).
rules.next_check: the last trading day of each month, at the close

rules.name: Nasdaq-100 with a 10-month trend filter
rules.desc: Hold QQQ while its month-end price is above its 10-month average; otherwise Treasury bills.
rules.next_check: the last trading day of each month, at the close

rules.name: Global dual momentum
rules.desc: Each month: if SPY beat T-bills over 12 months, hold the better of SPY and EFA (international); otherwise hold Treasury bonds (IEF).
rules.next_check: the last trading day of each month, at the close

rules.name: Sector momentum, top 3 of 9
rules.desc: Each month: hold the 3 S&P sector funds with the best 6-month return, equal weights.
rules.next_check: the last trading day of each month, at the close

rules.name: Bitcoin with a 200-day trend filter
rules.desc: Hold Bitcoin while its daily close is above its 200-day average; otherwise cash (USDT).
rules.rule: Classic trend following, as in Faber (2007)
